# Vendored OWL

Source derived from jedbillyb/owl commit
`832d70f815c3d4a06a02117bf0fc5e868daa1ff0`, based on seemoo-lab/owl,
with AWDL address, transmit-rate, action-frame padding and dynamic HT RX
capability fixes. See ../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md for provenance.
Builds from source for the target architecture. No device configuration or
prebuilt executable is included.
